question: What future identity will the addressed lord of gods assume?
premises: A future state is declared for the addressed one.
The addressed one is called lord of gods.
That future state involves bearing the name Mahiṣāsura.
inference: The lord of gods will become the one bearing the name Mahiṣāsura.
uncertainties: The referent of 'sa' in relation to 'tva' is contextually compressed.
plain_english: O lord of gods, you will become he who bears the name Mahiṣāsura.
